_comment: check-cg selftest: three repeater instantiations in rtl/top/rpt-units.json's form (tools/gen-top.py). One stage of one 64-bit slot, with a 16-bit lead slice and without: the lead's first-stage flops, written every cycle, take the instantiation past its own allowance; without them it passes. Two stages of a 16-bit slot: its nine control flops (valid, wake, credit and stall at each stage, and the flopped reset) are past a 41-flop module's allowance, and pass it because they count against the wrapper's budget instead (Daniel, 2026-10-19).

bench.build: verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=1 -GS=1 -GW=64 "-GLEAD=64'hffff" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv

verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=1 -GS=1 -GW=64 "-GLEAD=64'h0" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv

verilator --binary --timing --trace -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Irtl/include -Irtl/generated --top-module tb_cg_rpt -GSTAGES=2 -GS=1 -GW=16 "-GLEAD=16'h0" --Mdir {dir} -o tb rtl/ccv_assert_pkg.sv rtl/phys/ccv_common_rpt.sv test/cg/tb_cg_rpt.sv
